verdict.rationale: Moss documents official SDKs for Python and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node package @moss-js/moss, with class-level reference docs), plus Swift, Elixir, C and an in-browser WASM build. SDK-specific features such as minScore filtering and disk caching are also documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs beyond first-party docs and the vendor GitHub repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the Python or TypeScript SDK and run your first semantic search in minutes.
One model across every surface: JavaScript (Node), Python, Swift (iOS), Elixir, C, and an in-browser/WASM build.
The Node (`@moss-js/moss`) and Python SDKs can cache the downloaded index to disk so subsequent loads skip the download when the cloud data hasn’t changed.
In Python and JavaScript, set `min_score` (`minScore`) to drop low-relevance hits.
